Input Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the exact approved portrait facing VIEWER'S LEFT. Keep the exact 1122 x 1402 canvas and composition. Primary edit: change ONLY the small mouth and immediately adjacent lip skin, centered near (461,654). Preserve this angle's own foreshortening and nose-mouth-chin relationship. Match the source's delicate muted warm-gray/rose-brown linework and softly shaded pale skin. The upper lip stays anchored; the face does not move. Outside the local mouth area must remain unchanged. No text, labels, panels, accessories, additional faces or watermark. Return one full portrait, not a collage or sprite sheet.

Preserve central upper lip height and exact original facial proportions. Every feature outside local mouth skin stays unchanged. One full portrait; no cropping, panels, new design, text or watermark.

intermediateSources.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one independently authored asymmetric mouth for a 2D VTuber.
Input Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: approved 1122 x 1402 portrait facing VIEWER'S LEFT. Keep exact canvas, eyes, brows, nose, cheeks, chin, hair, neck, clothes, background and face shape unchanged.
CHANGE THE MOUTH ONLY, clearly different from the original smile. The character pulls their mouth toward THEIR RIGHT, i.e. VIEWER'S LEFT. Draw the VIEWER-LEFT mouth corner distinctly tugged LEFT and a little UP; let the VIEWER-RIGHT corner relax lower. The crease slopes down gently from the tugged LEFT corner toward the right side, with a small asymmetric inward curl at the LEFT corner. This is the OPPOSITE asymmetry from the source smile, whose viewer-right corner is higher. Do not preserve that right-corner-up smile.
Place mouth central crease about (449,654), roughly 12 pixels left of the original (461,654). Keep total width about 80 pixels and central upper-lip vertical level stable. CLOSED lips only, one delicate muted rose-brown line, natural soft anime lip tension. No mouth opening, white teeth, thick lips, lipstick, big grin or glossy highlight. Preserve source warm skin color and subtle shading. Only the mouth and immediately adjacent skin are edited, with no new features elsewhere. One full portrait, not a collage, crop or panel; no text or watermark.
intermediateSources.reason: New asymmetric crease but visible center was slightly right of neutral; dark corner and extended right tail required refinement.

processing: Source PNG bytes copied unchanged. Only angle-owned mouth patches are composited onto the approved pose. Registration is fixed native-size translation with per-source upper-lip anchors; no expression-dependent scale, warp, mirroring or crossfade. Gaze and existing eye/jaw sources are inherited unchanged.
limitations: Each new mouth action currently has one authored drawing per fixed side pose; no graded strengths or in-between drawings.
One-sided mouthPress is approximated by the same complete pressed mouth. Pucker and directional movement together select pucker; no combined mouth painting is implied.
Directional lips are independently drawn asymmetric creases; the visible lateral displacement is subtle and follows each source rather than an artificial fixed 12px motion.
Full source portraits are generated; only the registered local mouth region is used by the renderer.
The view-left shiftRight maximum-strength painting has a deeper closed corner crease than the other directional drawings; retained as a documented refinement point.
